title: Ukuru-class kaibokan (Japanese coastal escort)
ref: 78.8 m overall (navypedia: 72.5 pp, 77.5 wl, 78.8 oa; Wikipedia gives 77.7 m)
notes: Placed in the game with her keel at the painted sea level, so she floats about her full draught too high (see 'where she floats').

title: Daihatsu landing barge (Japanese harbours)
ref: 14.88 m (Daihatsu, Type A); 14 m in docs/research_1945_bases.md (naval bases)
notes: Bow ramp, open well with cargo, steering position aft. Works the anchored ships: at the home port one lies at the T-head and one shuttles between the freighter and the T-head; at each far harbour the civil ship's own barge shuttles to the jetty while she lies at anchor.

title: Wooden lighter (Japanese harbours)
notes: Alongside the anchored ships and at the T-head, loaded with crates and drums.

title: Timber A-frame derrick (home port T-head)
notes: Two on the T-head, leaning out over the berths; targets (as the old gantry cranes were). From docs/research_1945_bases.md (naval bases).

title: Coral-block mole with timber T-head (home port)
type: coral-block mole (stone jetty) with a timber T-head
ref: narrow masonry jetties 6-10 m wide, docs/research_1945_bases.md (naval bases)

Width is checked on the mole; the overall width is the T-head.

title: Type T-14 motor torpedo boat (Gyoraitei)
type: Type T-14 (No. 538 class) motor torpedo boat, IJN 1944-45
ref: 33-35 kn, one 920 hp Type 71 petrol engine, one shaft
notes: Wooden hard-chine planing hull with V frames, lofted from 26 stations: dark grey (variant 0) or mottled green (variant 1), red anti-fouling below the chine, a rubbing strake along the sheer.
Pilothouse forward of amidships with a raked three-pane windscreen; the open cockpit abaft it under a canvas hood, with the wheel; a signal mast with yard and masthead lamp on the pilothouse roof.

Two 45 cm Type 91 torpedoes on side-drop cradles along the deck edges, a Type 96 25 mm single on the after deck, four Type 95 depth charges on stern rails, the ensign at the transom. Crew shown: helmsman and gunner.
